user.title: E.ON Sweden – Log in
user.description: Enter your E.ON Sweden login credentials (same as eon.se/login/privat/username).

facilities.title: Select facilities
facilities.description: Choose which metering facilities to include. All are selected by default.

error.invalid_auth: Invalid personnummer or password. Please try again.
error.invalid_code: Invalid or expired code — open the login link again and paste the new code.
error.addon_unreachable: Cannot reach the auth add-on at this URL. Check it is installed and running.
error.addon_not_running: E.ON Auth add-on not detected. Make sure it is installed, started, and shows 'Running' in the add-on Info tab.
error.auth_failed: The add-on was reached but authentication failed. Check the add-on log: Settings → Add-ons → E.ON Sweden Auth → Log.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to E.ON Sweden. Check your internet connection and try again.
error.playwright_missing: Playwright is not installed. Install the E.ON Auth add-on instead.

abort.already_configured: This E.ON account is already configured.

data.facility_ids: Facility IDs to include (leave empty for all)
